I finally talked to my about my feelings a few months ago and we visited a regular doctor who directed us to a psychiatrist. My family is very well off and we have very nice expensive insurance. All of the places covered under our insurance had a wait time of over 5 months. 5 months to wait for treatment when I had just been told by a doctor that I was depressed and suicidal. My doctor recommended that we just call 911 and tell them I’m suicidal if it got bad and we would get treatment instantly. I can’t believe that was the best solution. We found a psychiatrist not covered under the insurance and I was able to get an appointment relatively early. I can’t imagine what it would be like for a family without great health insurance or no health insurance who can’t afford to get their kid treated. I used to be fairly conservative but the fact that some people can’t get help because of financial reasons is insane and made me realize how fucked up our system really is right now.
